search_window.basis: Since independently verified prior Food Line heartbeat; recency-limited targeted searches also reviewed recent overlapping material to avoid date-index misses.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall watch for high-value misses; primary nationwide Food Line production collector remains authoritative. No nationwide absence claim.
target_classes: Only/sole/last/full-service grocery lost to closure, fire or disaster
Emergency food distribution canceled or suspended due to storm, flood, fire, outage or damage
Abrupt food-pantry or food-bank shutdown or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.search_engine: web fast with 2-day recency setting; returned some historical results that were filtered by actual publication date.
search_queries: "only grocery store" fire closed November 10 2026 town
"sole grocery store" closure fire November 9 2026 United States
"emergency food distribution" suspended due to damage November 2026
SNAP EBT system outage benefits interrupted November 10 2026 state agency
WIC benefits office closed interrupted November 10 2026 state department

failures.error: Direct source fetch returned internal error/inaccessible; also unavailable in preceding runs.
failures.impact: Nonmaterial to this bounded run, given accessible state notices and targeted searches; official federal SNAP updates page was not cleared.

reviewed_exclusions.reason: Published Nov 9; scheduled holidays, not an abrupt weather/facility interruption; excluded as routine closure.
Nov 10 planned food distributions, not a cancellation or reduced access.
Previously noted documentation requirement starts Nov 21; no immediate cutoff in the observation window.
Ongoing longer telephone processing waits without new time-stamped interruption.
Sep 2 update confirms California WIC offices and benefits operational.
Nov 9 provider post advertises upcoming Clark and Trempealeau county distributions, not a cancellation.
Assistance and disaster-response resources, no new dated suspension apparent.

coverage_notes.excluded_categories: Previously reported or historical closures/fires, routine holiday closings, planned distributions, generic resource guides, promotional donation appeals, stale SNAP news and incidents without a newly confirmed immediate disruption.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new qualifying evidence in 12 targeted web searches and 9 direct-source checks. One persistently inaccessible USDA source endpoint; otherwise useful coverage retained.
